welcomeMessage:
Hello! I'm your Google Review Response Assistant for Stone Trail Villas. I can fetch your latest unanswered reviews and draft warm, professional responses in your brand voice.

Tap one of the quick actions below or type your request to get started.
clearedMessage: Conversation cleared. Ready to help with your Google reviews — what would you like to do?
inputPlaceholder: Ask me to fetch reviews, draft responses, or give tips…
